resume_requirements: Materialize all ten files from the one bound source commit using an authenticated mounted checkout, local Git object database, or another byte-faithful transport.
Compute Git blob SHA-1 for all ten files and require exact equality with the execution-input binding before running any canonical check.
Discard any reconstruction with one or more mismatches without classifying the canonical local gate as PASS or FAIL.
Then run the runner-focused tests, followed by the canonical seven-check aggregate runner and validate_result before persisting result schema v2.

parallel_head_conflict_check.interpretation: Parallel lane progress has not changed any bound E78.3 source/mechanics blob. This is a conflict check, not runtime Evidence.

validation_method.remote_range_diagnostic: GitHub create_blob over the exact fetched range may be used only to localize transport corruption; it does not replace complete-file binding verification.
validation_method.retired_intermediate_check: Ad-hoc SHA-256 prefix verification is not authoritative and must not be used to accept reconstructed source.
validation_method.correction_note: A scratch SHA-256 verifier produced a misleading intermediate agreement during a discarded reconstruction attempt. No canonical PASS, FAIL, or exact-materialization claim was based on that verifier; complete-file Git blob verification remains the acceptance criterion.
validation_method.accepted_chunk_transport: Per-chunk CRC32 is transport-integrity assistance only; acceptance still requires complete-file git hash-object equality with the bound Git blob SHA-1.

transport_progress.method: GitHub connector base64 line ranges -> local base64 decode -> per-range Git blob verification -> concatenation -> complete-file git hash-object
transport_progress.note: Range transport was accepted only after GitHub-side base64-derived blob SHA matched each local range and the concatenated complete file matched the canonical bound blob. No canonical runner execution was performed.
